title: Meet Anakh Sawhney, who began feeding kids at 9, has helped over 110,000
description: New Jersey teenager Anakh Sawhney started Rice Kids in 2018, aged nine, to provide meals to hungry children. Her nonprofit has since supported more than 110,000 people across five US states and parts of India through food, education, healthcare and other essential resources. More than half of the students supported by the organisation in India have returned to mainstream education.

title: Happy Choti Diwali 2026: Wishes, messages, images and quotes
description: Choti Diwali, or Naraka Chaturdashi, is the precursor to the grand Diwali festivities, celebrated to honor Lord Krishna's triumph over the wicked Narakasura. This day symbolizes new beginnings and the hope that comes with them. People partake in early morning rituals, adorn their homes, and prepare delightful sweets. Despite regional variations in customs, the festival fosters a spirit of compassion and encourages reflections on personal values and relationships.

title: Bronx home buyer demands $270,000 price cut, loses $1m lawsuit

After finding additional issues just days before the closing, he sought a considerable price decrease. The seller declined, referring to the contract terms and previous property condition disclosures.

title: Kenyan cult leader gets 200 years for starving 190 children to death
description: Paul Nthenge Mackenzie faces a staggering 200-year prison sentence for orchestrating the Shakahola massacre, which tragically claimed the lives of numerous church members, including 190 innocent children who reportedly starved under his directives. He manipulated his followers to believe that fasting would bring them closer to Jesus in the face of an impending apocalypse.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ $8 million Missouri estate: Inside his eight-acre luxury compound
description: Patrick Mahomes moved his family into a custom estate in Belton, Missouri, in 2023. He purchased the land for $400,000 in September 2020 and began construction shortly afterward. The estate includes a private football field, a pool, and a gym designed for family use. Mahomes has a Texas home for the off-season, but Belton serves as the family's base during football season.

title: GRAP 3 invoked across Delhi-NCR ahead of Diwali; several areas in 'severe' zone
description: The Commission for Air Quality Management has implemented Stage III of the Graded Response Action Plan due to severe air pollution. Delhi's average Air Quality Index was recorded at hazardous levels in multiple areas today. Municipal authorities deployed water sprinklers to control dust around India Gate and other locations. Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann faced criticism from Delhi's environment minister for misleading information about stubble burning.

title: China's helicopter arsenal grows, is India ready for the Himalayan challenge?
description: China is significantly enhancing its helicopter capabilities, focusing on new attack and transport models. The People's Liberation Army's investments could shift military balance along the Himalayan frontier against India. India, in response, is strengthening its own helicopter fleet with various indigenous and foreign platforms. Both nations are prioritizing aerial mobility for effective operations in challenging mountainous terrain. The ongoing developments highlight the evolving military dynamics between India and China.

title: Jobe Bellingham earns maiden England call-up, joins brother Jude for Nations League
description: Jobe Bellingham, the talented midfielder, has earned a spot in the England senior team for the upcoming fixtures. Joining his brother Jude, this unique family duo adds an interesting narrative to the matches against Croatia and Spain in the Nations League. After shining at Borussia Dortmund, Jobe's selection underscores his rapid ascent, while Cole Palmer and Phil Foden remain sidelined due to injuries.

title: 'She killed herself, I dumped body': Indian-origin man's on wife's murder trial in US
description: Naresh Bhatt, an Indian-origin individual, stands accused of murdering his wife, Mamta Kafle. During the trial, he claimed to have discovered her lifeless body, asserting it was a case of suicide in July 2024. However, evidence, including surveillance footage and forensic analysis, contradicts his account, revealing blood linked to Kafle. Despite the grave allegations, Bhatt asserts his innocence and pleads not guilty.

title: EC gives voters excluded from draft rolls in 7 states another chance to apply
2-year ban for ‘Clicky Ponting’, England club relegated with 60-point deduction
description: Brian Devine, nicknamed "Clicky Ponting", has been banned from cricket for two years after a viral video showed him allegedly faking an edge by clicking his fingers. Saltburn CC’s second XI has also been relegated and handed a 60-point deduction. While several public figures criticised the incident, cricket commentators felt the backlash against the amateur cricketer was excessive.

title: 2026 set to be second-hottest year ever recorded; El Nino yet to peak
description: The year 2026 is anticipated to be one of the warmest on record as global temperatures soar. Experts suggest that the prevailing El Niño will peak around this time, intensifying the risk of severe weather phenomena worldwide. The World Meteorological Organization warns of impending droughts and floods as a result, while projections hint that temperatures might rise even more in 2027, threatening existing climate balances.

title: Delhi HC flags Doosra's violation of Ganguly's rights, orders Rs 2 crore guarantee
description: The Delhi High Court ruled that the film Doosra violated Sourav Ganguly's personality rights, compelling producers to provide a bank guarantee. Despite this, the court allowed the film to continue its theatrical release, underscoring the importance of Ganguly's rights in the narrative. Producers are mandated to add disclaimers clarifying Ganguly's lack of consent for using his persona.

title: Sehwag's fifty, Ishan's three-for power India to 10-wicket win in Under-19 Asia Cup
description: Aaryavir Sehwag and Lakshya Raichandani remained unbeaten as India chased down the target of 129 in just 19.1 overs, with 30.5 overs to spare. Sehwag scored 70 off 52 balls, hitting seven fours and four sixes, while Raichandani made 53 off 63 balls, including seven boundaries.

title: Watch: Karmabhoomi Express coaches gutted in Punjab; short-circuit suspected
description: A fire erupted in three coaches of the Karmabhoomi Express in Patiala district, Punjab on Friday around 1pm. The sudden flames instilled fear in passengers as they spread quickly. Promptly, railway officials and emergency teams arrived to manage the situation, which was likely caused by a short circuit. Fortunately, all passengers were unharmed, and alternative transportation was arranged for their continued journey.

An appeals court ruled that the city could continue implementing this tax against high-value properties. Homeowners had expressed concerns regarding confusion about the tax's rollout, which had initially been challenged in court. The tax aims to generate significant revenue for city finances, despite ongoing legal disputes.

title: Zelenskyy eyes bipartisan US backing amid Ukraine's Patriot shortage crisis

He aims to reclaim essential military aid while stressing the immediate necessity for Patriot air defense missiles and the operational readiness of F-16 fighter jets as winter approaches.

Pakistan's external debt nearly doubles to $135 bn in 10 years, China biggest lender
description: Pakistan's external borrowing is projected to reach $135.1 billion by 2025, with much of the debt owed to China. The country's external debt increased from $68.673 billion in 2015 to the current level, reflecting a significant upward trend. Public and publicly-guaranteed borrowing comprises the majority of this debt, totaling around $107.076 billion. Private borrowing is notably more expensive, contributing to rising debt-service payments across developing countries.

Cases still pending will be examined individually by the courts based on merit and eligibility. The government expressed concerns that retrospective application could unsettle established positions and admissions. It sought two years to establish a uniform creamy layer mechanism across various sectors.

title: 'Several victims': Bus meets accident in eastern France near Switzerland
description: In the early morning hours, a grave bus crash occurred near the Swiss border in eastern France, involving a school bus. Local authorities have reported several casualties resulting from the incident. Education Minister Edouard Geffray verified the school bus's participation, with additional comments from the area prefect regarding an intercity bus.

title: Bomb threat to Amitabh Bachchan's bungalow, Bombay HC, BSE on Dhanteras
description: A bomb threat email was sent to the Bombay High Court, raising security concerns across Mumbai. Prominent locations mentioned include the Bombay Stock Exchange and Mahalaxmi Racecourse. The email also named Bollywood superstar Amitabh Bachchan's residence, Jalsa, as a potential target. Authorities are currently investigating the credibility of the threat and determining appropriate actions. Further details about this situation are expected shortly from official sources.

title: ‘Conditions to be similar’: Gill on why NZ ODIs are crucial for 2027 WC plans
description: Shubman Gill, captain of the Indian cricket team, emphasizes the importance of the ODI series against New Zealand, seeing it as a crucial preparation for the World Cup. He’s arrived early to adapt to the red ball for enhanced performance. India currently leads the series and is eager to clinch a win in Wellington, while New Zealand eyes a robust comeback.

Global equities suffered a sharp sell-off amid fading enthusiasm for artificial intelligence (AI) stocks following US President Donald Trump’s defeat in the midterm elections.

Indian rupee hits six-month high as foreign investors return to equities
description: The Indian rupee has reached a six-month high against the US dollar amidst changing investment trends. Foreign investors returned to Indian equities, purchasing nearly $3 billion in recent days. This shift comes as global markets facing losses reconsider their heavy exposure to technology stocks linked to AI. Lower crude oil prices have also provided relief to the Indian economy amid geopolitical developments.

Family massacre: Minor daughter assisted Bengaluru man at every stage of 7 killings
description: Indushekar is accused of murdering his wife and six of her relatives over domestic disputes. He reportedly disposed of the bodies in various locations, including near Nandi Hills. Police uncovered the case following a missing-person complaint filed by a relative of the victims. The accused's minor daughter is being questioned for her potential involvement in the crimes. Investigations are ongoing to locate the remaining bodies and verify the accused's claims.

title: 'A party invitation': How Bengaluru family was massacred inside house
description: Indushekar reportedly committed the murders of his wife and six family members over two days in Bengaluru. After the initial murder of Sunita, he allegedly invited his brothers-in-law to his home, where he killed them as well. The investigation revealed that he used a grinding stone for the killings and then attempted to clean the crime scene. A missing-person report prompted police to discover the situation and arrest Indushekar.

title: 'Stabbed 10 times': Chennai man kills wife with kitchen knife, surrenders
description: Vivek, a driver, surrendered at Neelankarai police station for stabbing his wife Muthupriya to death during a quarrel. The incident occurred at their rented house in Palavakkam, resulting in Muthupriya suffering ten stab wounds. After the murder, he left their daughter with his brother in Mudichur. Family members revealed Vivek had a history of mental health issues and had received treatment recently.

description: Every long-haul flight with a toilet problem, is crying for a systemic fix. And it’s quite doable

title: 2nd-gen Gujaratis script history in US midterms
description: Seven Indian-American candidates achieved victories in the US midterm elections, marking a significant milestone for the community. Ami Bera won in California’s 6th Congressional District, securing his position as the longest-serving Congressman of Indian origin. Amish Shah became the first Indian origin person elected to Congress from Arizona’s 1st Congressional District, highlighting community advancement. Their campaigns focused on key issues like affordable healthcare and social security for constituents.

title: Roads choke, cabs burn hole in pockets: Markets across Delhi teem with Diwali shoppers
description: Traffic congestion across Delhi increased significantly, especially around major markets during the Diwali shopping rush. Commuters faced delays on key roads, with some journey times stretching to nearly two hours. Cab fares saw a considerable increase due to high demand and restrictions on certain vehicles entering the city. Many commuters expressed their frustration regarding the traffic situation and rising transportation costs on social media.

title: Florida’s new property tax: Why tech execs move to ‘Billionaire Bunkers’ may be right
description: Florida voters have given a green light to Amendment 3, a game-changing overhaul of property tax laws in the state. This will greatly enhance the homestead exemption, tripling it and providing crucial tax relief to average homeowners. However, for the ultra-wealthy with sprawling estates, the advantages of the exemption will seem rather insignificant.

title: To ensure property goes to uncle, 2 relatives to kill 70-year-old woman in Bengaluru
description: A property dispute led to the murder of a 70-year-old woman in Bengaluru. The deceased, Venkatlakshmamma, was living alone after losing her husband and daughter. Relatives Kantharaju and Manjappa were arrested for attacking her over property disagreements. Police found clues suggesting that the murder was premeditated rather than a robbery gone wrong. Both suspects have confessed to their roles and remain in police custody.

title: Vivek and Zohran: A tale of two Indian-Americans
description: Dickens wrote of the spring of hope and the winter of despair as two seasons belonging to the same age. The American electorate witnessed both in November 2026. Mamdani chose hope. Ramaswamy chose despair. And the results suggested which had proved more persuasive.

title: Patrick Mahomes and wife Brittany help 60 young women find dream dresses
description: In 2024, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current partnered with Nuuly and United Way of Greater Kansas City to donate nearly 100 designer dresses to local young women. The initiative welcomed 60 members of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Kansas City, offering them outfits for special occasions. Players Hailie Mace, Gabrielle Robinson and Nichelle Prince also joined the event, which focused on confidence and self-expression.
